name: Hekinan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hekinan city emblem in red: a ring with four small points enclosing a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Hekinan, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 5 April 1948.

features.role: Hekinan city emblem — a ring with four small points enclosing a cross
